title: Keerthinthunu Ninne – Praveen Ritmos Telugu Christian Lyrics
english: krupalannyi thalapoyuchu manasaara ninne ne aaraadhinchedhanu
translation: I will praise You, O Most Praiseworthy One
I will glorify You, O Most High God
Approaching Your presence with a grateful heart,
I will offer a sacrifice of praise
Thinking of all Your mercies, I will worship You with all my heart
I will worship You… I will worship You…
Oh my Jesus, Jesus, my Jesus
I cannot live without praising You
Oh my Jesus, Jesus, my Jesus
I cannot live without You, even for a single moment
intro: Keerthinthunu Ninne is the latest Telugu Christian song written & tuned by Bobby, Sunith, sung by Praveen Ritmos and music composed by Sareen Imman and produced by Prabhakar Bobby, Prudhvi Raj. This song was released on July 01, 2026, through Praveen Ritmos YouTube Channel.
